headline: Bitget Intake Jumps To 864.9 Million Dollars From 464.2 Million
narrative: Bitget took in 864.9 million dollars over 24 hours, up from 464.2 million dollars, which means the largest stream of money is arriving at a venue where holders can sell. Clean-asset intake across 79 venues rose to 1,575.1 million dollars, 0.5642 percent of the 279.2 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from 1,110.9 million dollars. OKX posted a 99.7 million dollar outflow, the largest departure, while Binance took in 302.2 million dollars, Gate took in 216.4 million dollars, and Bitstamp took in 212.5 million dollars.
author: jordan
